admission.justification: Realized across the Manager role, manager-brief template and closeout/coordination/curation/implementation/review operations, guarded by wording and end-to-end preview tests, and required to complete FAM-PNH1QS's delegated coordination boundary.

applicability: Routine leaf paired closeout coordinated by a Manager across all masters, including standalone masters, together with the Curator's closeout check set and clean-sync refresh path.
conditions: The exact candidate has passing code and memory reviews, passing listed final checks, a clean closeout preview, an evidence map proving every item without waiver or substitution, and the Curator's report showing zero stale dependent-document rows from an exact-pair knowledge_read(view='dependent', staleOnly=true, codeTreeId='working-tree').

When a clean closeout preview returns commit_approval_required=true (would-closeout / commit-approval-pending / request_commit_approval), the Manager passes its standing leaf authority as intent_note to worktree_closeout_apply with explicit messages for enabled legs.

When a clean sync changes the code or memory pair, the Worker reruns focused tests and reports the pair, the existing review stays, and the Manager obtains the existing Curator's refreshed dependent-document read on the resulting pair before routine closeout.
exclusions: Non-routine closeouts with waived, environmental or substituted evidence, an open scope question, or an explicit Architect hold, which route to the Architect.
Final-work developer commit approvals, sprint-line pushes, pull requests, main landings and releases, which keep their existing Architect or developer authority.
Overlapping-path or failing-test sync repairs, which require exact repair and one look by the same Reviewer.
statement: The Manager applies routine paired closeout across all masters (including standalone masters) under standing series authority when the exact candidate has passing code and memory reviews (memory review alone on a consolidation leaf), passing listed final checks, a clean preview (passing standing leaf authority as intent_note when commit_approval_required is true), an unwaived evidence map, and the Curator's or Consolidator's exact-pair stale-dependent knowledge_read showing zero stale dependent-document rows (refreshed by the existing Curator or Consolidator after any clean sync that changes the pair while keeping the existing review).
title: Manager standing routine paired closeout and zero-stale dependent proof
